# Continuation brief

You are picking up an in-progress task. Read this fully, then execute. The user has NOT been re-prompted. Read CLAUDE.md first (NO Task/Agent/Explore tools in this repo — read files directly; main-only git; stage files by explicit path, never `git add -A`).

## The goal (req_1542, user verbatim)

> "inside of the iso3d editor, you select a prop, or a wall, floor, etc. and it lets you do a per-face texture placement on the thing. well, that doesnt quite translate from this mesh editor when they export into the game props … in the rig menu, give a rig for face selection that can accept a texture, we can use either multiple faces or just one to declare it is a texturable face from the shaders or images, and then its not just restrained to the paint mode inside the mesh editor"

End state: author named **texture slots** (face groups) in the Studio mesh editor → they carry through the cook → in the iso build editor's **FacePainter** a Studio-cooked prop exposes those slots as texture targets you can skin with any registry shader/image, AND the chosen texture renders both in the editor preview AND in the compiled game.

The full approved plan is at `/home/siah/.claude/plans/compiled-forging-quiche.md` — READ IT. It has the architecture, the data model, and the phase breakdown.

## Where things stand

**Phase 1 (Studio authoring) — DONE, committed `0bdb11050`.**
- `cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/editMesh.ts`: `EditMesh` gained optional `slots?: TextureSlot[]` (`{id,label}`). A face joins a slot via its EXISTING `face.material` number = index into `mesh.slots` (material was carried through all edits but read nowhere — confirmed). Pure helpers added: `addTextureSlot / assignFacesToSlot / clearFaceSlot / facesInSlot / slotOfFace / renameSlot / removeSlot / slotIndexById`. Tests in `editMesh.test.ts` (slot CRUD + survives loop cut; removeSlot re-keys). editMesh suite green (96/96 at the time).
- `cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/studiokit/StudioViewport.tsx`: a "texture slots" panel in FACE mode — `newSlotFromSelection`, inline rename (slotDrafts state), pick (reselect a slot's faces), add selection, delete. (Note: it lives in FACE mode, not the literal "rig menu", because face selection lives in face mode — flag this to the user; they may want it surfaced in the rig menu too.)

**Phase 2 (cook carries slots) — NOT STARTED.**
**Phase 3 (compiled render + iso targets) — NOT STARTED.**

Phases 2-3 now RIDE ON the cooked-prop texture pipe that was fixed this session (see below) — that pipe is the foundation. A per-slot texture is just another texture the loader decodes; reuse the prop-part FacePainter flow (rule of two).

## Critical context fixed THIS session (read before Phase 2/3)

Cooked Studio props were rendering grey-untextured in the compiled game (paint showed in editor only). Root cause + fix (committed `83b39ed01`):
- The MESH_PROPS lump shipped the paint atlas as raw RGBA that the BAKE had to decode via `@reactjit/image` `image().raw()` — but the bake runs under `tools/v8cli`, which has NO image-codec door (`__imageops_*` undefined; proved by decoding the real blob under v8cli → null). So decode silently failed → grey.
- Face decals work because they decode in the Zig LOADER (`framework/gpu/decal_raster.zig` `stbi_load_from_memory`); the game host links stb (`framework/c.zig`).
- FIX: MESH_PROPS lump → **v4** ships the atlas as ENCODED PNG bytes (bake = passthrough, no decode); `framework/world/constructor.zig decodeMeshProps` stbi-decodes at load into `tex_rgba`. `cart/hmsc-int/compile/worldGeometry.ts` (`cookedPropTexture` now passthrough, `encodeMeshProps` v4, `MESH_PROPS_LUMP_VERSION=4`) + `meshProps.test.ts` round-trip test. **This is the model for Phase 3: per-slot textures should ship PNG-through-lump and decode in the loader, NOT in the v8cli bake.** Do not try to decode images in the v8cli bake — it cannot.

Other commits this session (context, not part of req_1542): `cd163c74c` (object-move concave false-flag fix), `e236ee7ab` (Studio Center button + mirror painting, req_1538), `3f235623b` (paint-blob GC, req_1556).

## What you need to do next

1. Re-read `/home/siah/.claude/plans/compiled-forging-quiche.md` and skim the FacePainter consumer: `cart/hmsc-int/editors/build/FacePainter.tsx` (prop mode = named PARTS row → `piecePartTextureSet` → `prop.partTextures[partId]`) and `cart/hmsc-int/render3d/propParts.ts` (returns `[]` for `isImportedPropKind` — this is the gap to close for cooked props) and `cart/hmsc-int/render3d/parts.tsx` (the `Part` type; FacePainter only needs `id/label/material/textureable` from a part).

2. **Phase 2 — cook carries slots.** In `cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/cookedAsset.ts`: add `slots` (id/label/defaultMaterial) to `CookedAsset` and record per-slot triangle ranges (or a per-triangle slot index) in the flatten (`flattenModel` / `cookProp`), bump `schema`, fold slots into the asset `hash`. Carry the fields through `cookedAssetStream.ts` (de/serialize). Tests in `cookedAsset.test.ts` / `cookedAssetStream.test.ts`: slots round-trip; an un-slotted model produces a byte-identical asset to today (back-compat).

3. **Phase 3 — render + iso targets.**
   - `cart/hmsc-int/render3d/propParts.ts`: for a cooked kind, return a `Part[]` from the cooked asset's slot table (`cookedAssetById(kind)` — already used by CookedProp) instead of `[]`. Then FacePainter lights up automatically (no FacePainter change needed) and writes `piecePartTextureSet` → `prop.partTextures[slotId]`.
   - Editor render `cart/hmsc-int/render3d/props/CookedProp.tsx`: render per-slot sub-ranges; a slot with `prop.partTextures[slotId]` resolves the registry texture (`resolvePartTexture` / the texture registry), else the baked atlas/default.
   - Compiled render: extend the MESH_PROPS lump + `constructor.zig`/`world_loader.zig` so a placed cooked prop's per-slot texture override ships (PNG-through-lump, decode in loader — the v4 pattern above) and renders the slot's sub-mesh with the override.

4. Build-verify each phase: bundle+run the touched `*.test.ts` via `tools/esbuild … --alias:@reactjit=$PWD/runtime --alias:@game=$PWD/cart/hmsc-int/game | tools/v8cli`; for Zig changes (`constructor.zig`), `SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship hmsc-int` to confirm it compiles. Commit each phase separately by explicit path with `(USER ASK req_1542)` in the message.

## Constraints, conventions, gotchas

- **v8cli has NO image-codec door.** Never decode images in the bake; ship PNG bytes and decode in the Zig loader (stbi). This is THE lesson of this session.
- The cooked asset id is `studio.<sceneName-slug>` — two same/blank-named models collide on id (latent, not biting). Latent bug noted: the mesh-prop sink dedups by `meshRef` with the texture riding the mesh, so two cooked props with identical geometry but different paint would collide — key on `(meshRef, texRef)` if you touch that.
- Slots are additive/back-compat: a part/prop with no slots must behave exactly as before.
- Build: `tools/rjit ship <cart>` / `SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 …` for fast verify. TSX changes hot-reload in `rjit dev`; Zig/framework changes need a rebuilt host. NEVER `./scripts/ship` directly. Don't pgrep-wait for builds (self-match).
- Request board: claim `tools/request move req_1542 doing --by <you>`; when phases land, `tools/request move req_1542 review --by <you> --para "…" --shas <…>` then STOP (only the user flips review→done). The Stop hook nags about in-flight claims every turn — declare "in flight" and stop, that's fine.
- Memory: see `~/.claude/projects/-home-siah-creative-reactjit/memory/` — relevant: `project_studio_pixel_painter`, `project_v20_store_sqlite`, `hmsc_paint_blob_bloat`, `project_decal_editor_textures_door`, `project_compiled_world_materials`, `feedback_match_reference_dont_ask_abstract_ux`, `feedback_commit_reflexively_never_ask` (the user dislikes being asked obvious decisions — just do them, with a backup for destructive ops).

## Known open issue (NOT part of req_1542 — do not chase unless asked)

OLD painted models (e.g. `pepes`, id `mdl-mqjo0ys2-3sw`) render GREY in the mesh editor paint mode on a fresh host boot, even though their paint blob is provably present + valid 1024² PNG in the store (`cart/hmsc-int/data/domains/model/store.db`). A clean rebuilt host (`zig-out/bin/hmsc-int`, includes the paint-GC) did NOT fix it. NEW paint saves and restores fine, so the system works going forward — this is a restore-on-open gap for pre-existing blobs only. The user has accepted it for now ("i painted a new one tho and it seems to save which is fine"). If asked to fix: instrument the restore path in `StudioViewport.tsx` (the `useEffect` ~line 1077 calling `restorePaint`) and `meshPaintTexture.ts restorePaint` — confirm whether `props.paintBlob(props.paintRef)` returns the blob at restore time (it should, post-full-replay) vs `restorePaint` failing. A full store backup exists at `~/store-backup-20260621-050018-model/`.

## What comes next (after req_1542 is done)

Texture slots are the editor-side authoring; the deeper arc is the LOCKED material/decal pipeline (V24/V28: piece→shape→position→face-materials). Once slots round-trip, the natural next leg is unifying cooked-prop slot textures with the existing decal/material lump path so there's one texture pipe, not two. Not now — just the horizon.

## How to report back

Per-phase: commit by explicit path (`feat(hmsc-int): … (USER ASK req_1542)`), then move req_1542 to `review` with a ≥120-char paragraph + the SHAs, and STOP. Do not flip to done — only the user does that. The user verifies in their dev loop (iso build → Compile → /compiled). Don't go live or swap anything unilaterally (their standing rule: build beside, hand back, they flip the wire).
